definitions.explanation: A group of people organized and sent to explore, research, or accomplish a specific mission in a distant or challenging location.
A military force dispatched to fight in a foreign territory.

examples.japanese: {遠征隊|えんせいたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{編成|へんせい}する→編成する：22370_henseisuru⟧。
⟦{南極|なんきょく}→南極：11936_nankyoku⟧{遠征隊|えんせいたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}した→出発する：01832_shuppatsusuru⟧。

⟦{登山|とざん}→登山：03457_tozan⟧{遠征隊|えんせいたい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{悪天候|あくてんこう}→悪天候：16184_akutenkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦{頂上|ちょうじょう}→頂上：03493_choujou⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}→挑戦：03495_chousen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{断念|だんねん}した→断念する：20717_dannensuru⟧。
examples.english: The mountaineering expedition gave up its attempt on the summit due to bad weather.

examples.english: A large-scale expeditionary force crossed the sea and landed in enemy territory.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{遠征|えんせい}→遠征：21155_ensei⟧ (expedition) and ⟦{隊|たい}→隊：03383_tai⟧ (group, squad, party). Can refer to both civilian exploration/research expeditions and military expeditionary forces. In modern usage, sense 1 (civilian expedition) is more common, especially in contexts of mountaineering, polar exploration, and scientific research.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{登山|とざん}→登山：03457_tozan⟧{遠征隊|えんせいたい}: mountaineering expedition
- ⟦{南極|なんきょく}→南極：11936_nankyoku⟧{遠征隊|えんせいたい}: Antarctic expedition
- ⟦{探検|たんけん}→探検：17461_tanken⟧{遠征隊|えんせいたい}: exploration expedition
- {遠征隊|えんせいたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{派遣|はけん}→派遣：13273_haken⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to dispatch an expedition
- {遠征隊|えんせいたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}む→組む：02050_kumu⟧: to form an expedition

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{探検隊|たんけんたい}→探検隊：25022_tankentai⟧: exploration party — focuses on discovering unknown areas
- {調査隊|ちょうさたい}: survey/research team — focuses on investigation and data collection
- ⟦{遠征|えんせい}→遠征：21155_ensei⟧: expedition — the act or event itself, without the group implication
